lines.en: Rina, have you seen our colleague today? She’s been working on that big project for weeks.
lines.pt: Rina, você viu nossa colega hoje? Ela está trabalhando naquele grande projeto há semanas.

lines.en: I know. She’s been coming in at seven every morning, and she’s been staying until after dark.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Ela tem chegado às sete toda manhã, e tem ficado até depois de escurecer.

lines.en: I’m worried. She hasn’t been eating lunch, and she’s been drinking coffee all day long.
lines.pt: Estou preocupado. Ela não tem almoçado, e tem tomado café o dia inteiro.

lines.en: Her team has been helping her, but the client has been changing the plans every week.
lines.pt: A equipe dela tem ajudado, mas o cliente tem mudado os planos toda semana.

lines.en: That explains it. We’ve been testing the new software since January, and the results have been disappointing.
lines.pt: Isso explica. Testamos o novo software desde janeiro, e os resultados têm sido decepcionantes.

lines.en: Have you been talking to the manager about the deadline? Somebody has to ask for more time.
lines.pt: Você tem falado com o gerente sobre o prazo? Alguém precisa pedir mais tempo.

lines.en: I have, but she’s been travelling, so she hasn’t been answering my emails properly.
lines.pt: Falei, mas ela tem viajado, então não tem respondido direito aos meus e-mails.

lines.en: Typical. I’ve been thinking about a solution: what if we split the work between three teams?
lines.pt: Típico. Tenho pensado numa solução: e se dividíssemos o trabalho entre três equipes?

lines.en: That could work. Who has been handling the budget so far? We need those figures first.
lines.pt: Isso pode funcionar. Quem tem cuidado do orçamento até agora? Precisamos desses números primeiro.

lines.en: Our colleague has, of course. She’s been checking every number herself, and she’s been refusing any help.
lines.pt: A nossa colega, claro. Ela tem conferido cada número sozinha, e tem recusado qualquer ajuda.

lines.en: Then let’s bring her some lunch and gently insist. She’s been carrying this project alone for too long.
lines.pt: Então vamos levar um almoço para ela e insistir com jeito. Ela carrega esse projeto sozinha há tempo demais.

facts.label: Projetos em andamento
facts.sub: Ação em processo: She’s been working on it. Duração: for weeks. Começo: since January. Negativa: hasn’t been eating. Pergunta: Who has been…?

facts.label: Em progresso
facts.sub: Use have/has been + -ing para um projeto que continua: She’s been working on a big project. Não importa se ele termina em breve; o foco é o processo, a duração e o esforço.

facts.label: Há / desde
facts.sub: For + período: for weeks. Since + começo: since January. Ambos acompanham o present perfect contínuo: We’ve been testing it since January. Não use since com um período.

items.s: “She’s been working on it for weeks” shows work in progress.
Hasn’t been eating means she has finished eating.
items.why: It means she is not eating regularly.

items.s: Since goes with a starting point.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “She’s been working on it for weeks” shows work in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Hasn’t been eating means she has finished eating. → Falso (It means she is not eating regularly.)
Since goes with a starting point. → Verdadeiro (Since January.)

pages.title: A big project at the office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Tuesday afternoon in Seattle. The office on the tenth floor is quiet and a little tense. A big software project is almost late. Gabe stands near the coffee machine with a worried face. His coworker Leo arrives with a pile of papers. They want to help a tired colleague.

“Leo, have you seen our colleague today? She’s been working on that big project for weeks.” says Gabe. “I know. She’s been coming in at seven every morning, and she’s been staying until after dark.” says Leo. “I’m worried. She hasn’t been eating lunch, and she’s been drinking coffee all day long.” says Gabe.
